## Added

- In-game settings for external mods, including switches, bounded integers and lists. Values persist between launches and can be reset to defaults.
- Localized mod names, descriptions and setting labels. Mod cards show the author and version.
- Dependency and conflict checks with deterministic startup order and messages explaining blocked changes.
- SDK 2 with settings access, menu and language events, per-mod logging and a bounded game-thread task queue. The release includes an example with a manifest.
- Safe mode for troubleshooting startup problems.

## Fixed

- Faulting mod callbacks disable the mod, cancel its queued tasks and stop its dependent mods.
- Keyboard-triggered enable and disable now run in the render pass, consistent with mouse-triggered changes.
- Removed redundant menu geometry copies on the window-message and render paths.

## Compatibility

Existing ABI 1 mods remain supported. The supported Hello Neighbor GOG build is unchanged. The new queue schedules tasks, and the SDK does not expose Unreal game objects.
